events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: MTV first launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed the Radio Star" being the first music video aired.

angles.name: MTV Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the day music television changed everything? Forty-five years ago, MTV hit the airwaves and kicked off a new era for artists.

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring hits like "Supersonic" and "Live Forever".

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, bringing together nearly half a million people for "3 Days of Peace & Music".

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the Woodstock Festival delivered three days of peace, love, and iconic music that defined a generation.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the "King of Rock and Roll", passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, the world lost a true icon. Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a profound voice. Remembering the enduring legacy of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago today, we lost one of music's most revolutionary guitarists. Remembering Jimi Hendrix.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, featuring tracks like "Come Together" and "Something".

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover walk is still one of the most famous in history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking strong after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger to British music.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album 'Imagine' in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' album offered a message of peace and unity to the world.

events.title: First iPod announced 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, promising "1,000 songs in your pocket" and revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod was unveiled, changing how we listen to music on the go forever. Remember your first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the 1962 premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, marking 64 years of the iconic spy.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and a legendary solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled musical genius of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic legend, John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed their experimental masterpiece, 'The White Album'. What's your hidden gem from the tracklist?
